Training for the Warsaw Independence Run, 10 km on 11 November.
about: I’m Ọláṣùbòmí. Born in Nigeria, based in Warsaw, trained as an architect at the University of Lagos.

I spend my days creating designs that help my clients position their products in front of the right audience. Over the years I’ve grown from seeing design as just pixels to seeing how it actually moves the needle, for Fortune 500 companies around the world.

Music has been a big part of my life. It transforms the way I see the world. I care about staying fit, and I care about my family more than anything else: my mom, my dad, my sister, my brother and my beautiful wife, Paula.

This site is my tiny corner of the internet, where I share my thoughts and curate my time on this crazy planet. I’m happy to be here, and I’ll do my level best to fill this space with as much as I’m willing to share. See you around.
workLine: By day I run Colorteam, a design-led marketing agency that helps personal and business brands find their position in the market, reach the right audience, and grow revenue through sharp go-to-market execution.
open: Always happy to swap playlists, routes and good reads. Feel free to say hello.
